postmortem.root_cause: Block blk_-1001299764911418845 was reported as belonging to no file, indicating metadata inconsistency or a failed write job.
postmortem.summary: A block was successfully created and replicated across multiple DataNodes, but later reports indicated it did not belong to any file. The block was eventually added to the invalidSet and deleted from the filesystem. This suggests a failure in the writing job or metadata tracking that resulted in an orphaned block report.

2008-11-10T10:31:09+00:00: The block was added to the invalidSet by multiple DataNodes (blk_-1001299764911418845#18, blk_-1001299764911418845#19).

recommended_actions: Investigate writing jobs around 2008-11-09T21:16:57+00:00 to see if they were cancelled or failed.
Review NameNode logs for any metadata corruption events during the block's lifecycle.
Monitor for a surge in orphan block reports to determine if this was an isolated incident or part of a larger namespace issue.

RB-004#Symptom.text: Block reported that belongs to no file - Symptom: The NameNode logs `addStoredBlock request received for blk_... on <dn> size <n> But it does not belong to any file.` when a DataNode reports a block the NameNode has no file for.

RB-004#Checks.text:
Block reported that belongs to no file - Checks: 1. Look for `NameSystem.delete` lines that mention the same block close in time.
2. Check whether the writing job was cancelled or failed.
3. Confirm whether the block later appears in an invalidSet.

RB-004#Escalate.text: Block reported that belongs to no file - Escalate: Escalate if orphan reports are numerous, since that can mean namespace metadata was lost.

RB-011#Symptom.text: Corrupt block replica - Symptom: A replica fails checksum verification during a read or the block scanner.

RB-012#Fix.text: Block scanner and read errors while serving - Fix: Usually client-side and safe to ignore in small numbers. Investigate when rates rise.

RB-005#Escalate.text: Redundant addStoredBlock requests - Escalate: Escalate if the NameNode RPC queue is backing up.

RB-005#Checks.text:
Redundant addStoredBlock requests - Checks: 1. Check NameNode RPC latency around the report time.
2. See whether the DataNode restarted or re-registered recently.
